records.author: Contributor 04
records.title: Annual service strategy
records.body: The committee proposes a future service operating model with clearer reporting, reliable staffing and a shared dashboard. Contributor 01 attended the planning meeting. This is a proposal, not a delivery report.

records.author: Contributor 02
records.title: Desk request
records.body: I propose a small trial for staff to find the next action on a book hold without checking several screens. Contributor 01 offered to build it. I own circulation policy and keep approval rights.

records.author: Contributor 01
records.title: Shelf helper trial
records.body: I implemented Shelf helper as a limited staff desk tool. It reads the next step for a hold and asks for confirmation before a change. Contributor 03 implemented the catalogue adapter; I wrote the desk workflow. This commit does not establish live use.

records.author: Contributor 01
records.title: Shelf helper trial opens
records.body: Shelf helper is available to the afternoon desk team for a trial. We kept the existing shared workstation rather than adding a login at each handoff. Please report confusing answers; this is not approved for all branches.

records.author: Contributor 03
records.title: Scope problem
records.body: The trial showed a hold note from another branch to our desk volunteers. I stopped the trial and reported the access error. Contributor 01 agreed to narrow the lookup before we resumed.

records.author: Contributor 01
records.title: Scope correction
records.body: I changed the lookup to require the staff branch and removed free-text hold notes from the response. Contributor 03 wrote the failing reproduction and reviewed the correction. We tested the reproduction successfully; a complete security audit has not been performed.

Desk follow-up: Shelf helper was renamed Beacon after the scope correction. Contributor 02 now runs the trial on the afternoon shift; Contributor 01 handed over a short troubleshooting guide and remains available for repairs. The morning shift still uses the old process.

Learning session: Contributor 01 ran a practice session with volunteers and added an illustrated guide for those who could not attend. Contributor 05 contributed the examples. Nobody measured learning gains.

records.author: Contributor 02
records.title: Beacon shift report
records.body: We used Beacon on three afternoon shifts this week and still needed a manual check when the catalogue was stale. The guide helped a new volunteer recover a failed lookup. I suggested adding a catalogue freshness notice. This is my shift report, not an organisation-wide usage count.

records.author: Contributor 05
records.title: Practice follow-up
records.body: I reused the illustrated guide to train another volunteer without Contributor 01 present. One exercise was confusing, so I sent an edit and Contributor 01 corrected it. We have not established a regular training schedule.
